'''Not a Decipher scan.''' This is the Players Committee's 2007 card-gallery image of [[Colo Claw Fish]] at swccgpc.com. It prints the same card text as Decipher's printed card (no errata wording and no bronze disc). The picture matches Decipher's own scan except for the colour of the Effect icon. Decipher's own scan is [[:File:Ref3-L-coloclawfish-decipher-archive.jpg]], which the card's article and set table now show.

Source: [http://web.archive.org/web/20071122131925id_/http://www.swccgpc.com/cards/reflections3/ls/coloclawfish.jpg coloclawfish.jpg] in the Players Committee card gallery at swccgpc.com (Internet Archive, 22 November 2007). This wiki file is a flush crop of it (350×490, corner pads bleached white), uploaded 25 September 2026 under the misleading name ReflectionsIII-L-coloclawfish-decipher-archive.gif and moved to this name on 12 November 2026 (the old name redirects here).

'''Do not''' replace Holotable [[:File:Ref3-L-coloclawfish.gif]].

Fair use rationale: this is a low-resolution image of a copyrighted Star Wars Customizable Card Game card, © Lucasfilm Ltd. and Decipher Inc. It is used only to identify and discuss the card on this non-commercial fan wiki, it does not replace any product sold today, and no free equivalent exists.
